refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoInstallMathFunctions function installs the functions supporting the C math.h functions into destination.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoInstallMathFunctions returns true if all functions were installed successfully, false otherwise. If false was returned, then the selection of functions installed in the SilikoEngine object is unspecified.
